import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { FlightSearchService, Flight, LayoverConnection } from '../../services/search.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-search', templateUrl: './search.component.html', styleUrls: ['./search.component.css'] }) export class FlightSearchComponent { /*depart: string = ''; destination: string = '';*/ loading = false; errorMessage = ''; directFlights: Flight[] = []; layoverConnections: LayoverConnection[] = []; constructor(private flightSearchService: FlightSearchService) {} search(depart: string, destination: string) { this.errorMessage = ''; this.loading = true; this.directFlights = []; this.layoverConnections = []; this.flightSearchService.searchFlights(depart, destination).subscribe({ next: (data) => { this.loading = false; if (data.length === 0) { this.errorMessage = 'Nessun volo trovato.'; return; } // Capire se sono voli diretti (Flight[]) o con scalo (LayoverConnection[]) if ('firstLeg' in data[0]) { // sono connessioni con scalo this.layoverConnections = data as LayoverConnection[]; } else { // voli diretti this.directFlights = data as Flight[]; } }, error: (err) => { this.loading = false; this.errorMessage = err.error?.errormessage || 'Errore durante la ricerca voli.'; } }); } }
